notes: Cortex remembers your conversations. The one you are in is still there when you open the app again, and when a conversation ends it keeps a few sentences about it in its own words, sealed on your phone, so next time it knows what you talked about (Cortex > Memory > What we talked about: forget any or all). It also asks back when a question could mean two things, and goes step by step when you ask it to think something through.
